title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note: MEAT (Monitor, Evaluate, Assess/Address, Treat) is an industry mnemonic, not CMS wording. The underlying rule is coding conditions that coexist and affect care at the encounter.

labels.med_list_only: A medication on the list only

describe.meat_supported: The provider addresses the condition at this visit in the assessment and plan: at least one of monitor, evaluate, assess or treat (e.g. stable, symptoms reviewed, continue medication, will monitor).
describe.problem_list_only: The condition appears ONLY in a 'Problem List' section. It is not mentioned in the history, exam, assessment or plan; the visit is about something else.
describe.med_list_only: A medication for the condition appears ONLY in a 'Medication List' section. The condition itself is never named anywhere in the note; the visit is about something else.

missed_supported_condition.description: Did not code a chronic condition the provider monitored, evaluated, assessed or treated.

coded_without_meat.description: Coded a condition that only appears in a problem list or history without being addressed.

coded_from_med_list.description: Inferred and coded a diagnosis from a medication list.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when severity/type was documented.
